verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an error-monitoring SaaS that ships SDKs and a CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a way to opt out of BugSnag's own telemetry or usage tracking. The nearby evidence covers different features and earns no credit: retroactive sensitive-data redaction, before-notify callbacks that filter which app errors get reported, discard rules, and self-hosted on-premise deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
